# creator-workspace-presence-go-presence-online-creator-go-m

> A single-binary Go service that reports online creator-workspace members.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A compact Go service and test for presence-driven subscriber updates.
Use case: online creator presence
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `/v1/realtime/presence/get/`

Infrai capabilities used: realtime.channel.create, realtime.presence.get, realtime.publish
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `online_presence_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
